items.section_heading: VERY SHORT ANSWER QUESTIONS
items.stem: Why do you think the author chose the title 'The Unlikely Best-friends' for this story?
items.answer: The author chose the title 'The Unlikely Best Friends' for this story as the friends the dog and the elephant, two very different animals become friends. A dog is very different from an elephant in all aspects. However, in the story we see that they play together, eat together and overcome their differences. Even though it is very 'unlikely' or unexpected, the dog and the elephant still become best-friends.

items.section_heading: VERY SHORT ANSWER QUESTIONS
items.stem: Describe the activities Gajaraj and Buntee do together.
items.answer: Gajaraj and the Buntee spend time together, with the Buntee even accompanying Gajaraj for his bath. Gajaraj playfully splashes water on the Buntee and they enjoy each other's company. They eat together and Gajaraj even gives Buntee a ride on his back.

items.section_heading: Answer The Following Questions In Short.
items.stem: Describe the first meeting between Gajaraj and Buntee. How did their friendship develop?
items.answer: The first meeting between Gajaraj and Buntee was nothing abnormal. Gajaraj was a royal elephant who lived in the royal stable along. One day, Buntee, a stray dog, wandered into the royal stables. Noticing that the dog was tired and hungry, Gajaraj offered him some of his food, which instantly formed a bond between him and Buntee. Despite their differences, Gajaraj was drawn to Buntee's friendliness. They both began playing together, going to the pond for the bath together, sharing food and spending time in each other's company.This is how their bond grew stronger and they became unlikely bestfriends.

items.section_heading: Answer The Following Questions In Brief.
items.stem: Explain the role of the farmer in the story. How did his actions contribute to the development of the friendship between Gajaraj and Buntee?
items.answer: The farmer is introduced to us as Buntee, the dog's owner. He initially took Buntee away from Gajaraj as the dog was his pet and he had been looking for the dog for some time. However, when the farmer noticed that Buntee's sadness was due to the absence of his friend, the farmer showed compassion and allowed Buntee to visit Gajaraj. This

items.section_heading: Answer The Following Questions In Brief.
items.stem: act of kindness ultimately helped make the friendship between the elephant and the dog stronger. The story teaches us that friendship can blossom between the most unlikely individuals. Give examples from the story to support this statement.
items.answer: The story of Gajaraj and Buntee beautifully shows that friendship can blossom between the most unlikely individuals. Despite their differences in size, species, and needs the elephant and the dog formed a deep bond of friendship. They could not speak, but only show their kindness and happiness to each other. Gajaraj showed his kindness by sharing his food with Buntee. Buntee showed his love for Gajaraj by accompanying him everywhere. They enjoyed each other's company, played together, and cared for each other's well being. This unlikely friendship highlights the power of love and acceptance, showing that true friendship goes beyond outward appearances.
